platform: Liquicity Records Official Label Engine Demo Upload Route
manual_review_reason: Liquicity explicitly routes all music submissions to a Label Engine form that requests artist name, real name, email, up to five titled MP3 uploads, optional social profiles and a short message. The form displayed unresolved template variables during passive review, and its current file limits, privacy text, rights declarations and runtime anti-spam controls were not fully exposed. A human must verify that the form is correctly bound to Liquicity, select and upload only authorized final tracks, review consent and rights terms, approve personal data and submit manually.

platform: Circus Records / Circus Electric Official LabelRadar Demo Route
manual_review_reason: Circus explicitly accepts demos through LabelRadar only. The Circus-specific portal rendered only a dynamic loading shell, creating an account, login, session, terms, privacy, submission-credit and possible optional-payment boundary. A human must authenticate through the authorized portal, confirm that the campaign is open, choose the correct Circus Records or Circus Electric fit, inspect current pricing and submission limits, review rights and consent terms, approve the track and metadata, and submit manually. The public general-information mailbox must not be repurposed as a demo-delivery route.

platform: Monstercat Uncaged / Instinct / Silk Official LabelRadar Demo Routes
manual_review_reason: Monstercat provides separate authorized LabelRadar routes for Uncaged, Instinct and Silk. The portals rendered only dynamic loading shells and require a human to handle the account, login, session, current campaign, possible submission-credit, terms, privacy and consent boundaries. A human must choose the correct imprint, verify that the work is original and represents the artist's best material, inspect current eligibility and pricing, approve rights and metadata, and submit manually. Support, press, event and general contact routes must not be used for demo delivery.
